source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Scan through all the test records and verify that there is an attached specification with a pass/fail criterion and that the test has a pass/fail outcome. If you do not see records that meet this requirement, follow up with the author of the product performance report to verify the records and to have them completed, if applicable.
3. Copy and paste rows of data from the test records that do not meet the pass/fail criterion for the product performance report.
4. Once you have all relevant test rows, place a column in the consumer category (column D) and indicate as to whether the test is a partial fail or category fail (see images 1 and 2 below):

5. Once you have established whether the test is a partial fail or category fail, summarize those failures in your product performance report.
6. Provide a summary of the results and explain that the failures are based on the specific test method.<eos>
